title: 9 Most Anticipated Upcoming Anime From Jujutsu Kaisen Studio
content: Established in 2011, animation studio MAPPA took only a few years to become one of the biggest in the industry. The studio is best known for creating famous shows such as Jujutsu Kaisen , Chainsaw Man, Attack on Titan (from Season 4), and many more acclaimed series.
author: ComicBook

title: Shangri-La Frontier Season 3 First Trailer Teases Galaxia Heroes Chaos Action
content: Shangri-La Frontier Season 3 revealed the first teaser trailer teasing Galaxia Heroes: Chaos action ahead of its January 2027 release date. Studio C2C is again in charge of the animation. The anime was announced alongside the franchise’s first game adaptation immediately after the second season’s finale.
author: Anime Corner

title: Manga '7-nin no Nemurihime' Gets TV Anime in 2027
content: Production company Avex Pictures opened an official website for a television anime adaptation of Lee Fiok 's 7-nin no Nemurihime ( Seven Sleeping Beauties ) manga on Tuesday, revealing the main cast, staff, and a super teaser visual (pictured right). The anime is scheduled to premiere in 2027.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Fiok Lee's Seven Sleeping Beauties Manga Gets TV Anime in 2027
content: A website opened on Tuesday to announce the television anime adaptation of Fiok Lee 's Seven Sleeping Beauties ( Shichinin no Nemuri-hime ) manga, slated for 2027 debut. The website also revealed a super teaser visual, and the anime's main cast and staff members.
author: ANN

title: Witch on the Holy Night Anime Film Announces November 20 Premiere
content: The " Mahōtsukai no Yoru Release Date Announcement Event" on Tuesday revealed that the anime film of Type-Moon 's visual novel PC game Mahōtsukai no Yoru ( Witch on the Holy Night ) will premiere on November 20.
author: ANN

title: Witch on the Holy Night New Trailer Reveals November 20 Premiere
content: Witch on the Holy Night anime movie by ufotable revealed a new teaser trailer and confirmed a November 20, 2026 release date. The project was first announced back in December 2021, while the first teaser video was revealed in December 2023.
author: Anime Corner

title: Mushoku Tensei Season 3 Reveals New Rudeus Greyrat Character Visual Ahead of Upcoming Arc
content: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 3 revealed a character visual for Rudeus Greyrat ahead of the next arc in the anime. Following the Eris Training Arc from the first two episodes, the anime is going into the Rudeus Adolescence Arc starting with Episode 3 on July 12.
author: Anime Corner

title: Seven Sleeping Beauties Anime Announced for 2027, Reveals Main Cast and Staff
content: Fiok Lee’s fantasy romantic comedy manga Seven Sleeping Beauties ( 7-nin no Nemuri Hime ) is officially getting a TV anime adaptation. The series is scheduled to release in 2027, with the announcement revealing an ultra teaser visual, a commemorative illustration by the creator, and the main cast and staff.
author: Anime Corner

title: The Demons Are Planning Something Good Anime Reveals Cast, More Staff, 2027 TV Debut
content: The official website for the anime of akuji Katō's The Demons Are Planning Something Good ( Ma no Mono-tachi wa Kuwadateru ) comedy manga revealed the anime's cast, more staff, visual, and 2027 television debut on Tuesday.
author: ANN

title: 'Ma no Mono-tachi wa Kuwadateru' Announces Main Cast, Additional Staff, 2027 Premiere
content: An official website opened for the television anime adaptation of Takuji Katou and Gashigashi 's Ma no Mono-tachi wa Kuwadateru ( The Demons Are Planning Something Good! ) manga on Tuesday and revealed the main cast, additional staff, and a teaser visual (pictured). The anime is planned to premiere in 2027.
author: MyAnimeList
